# SvelteForge

> **sv community addon** — UI/UX layer on top of `sv create`. Adds 34 production-ready components, a 3-layer theme system, admin dashboard, notification system, and Zod schemas to SvelteKit projects. Auth (better-auth) and database (Drizzle + SQLite) come from `sv` add-ons.

## Install

```bash
sv create my-app --template minimal --types ts --add tailwindcss @ludoloops/svelteforge
# or add to existing project:
sv add @ludoloops/svelteforge
```

Prompts for template mode: **Landing Page** (UI only) or **Full Stack** (UI + dashboard + auth + DB).

## Stack

- SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (runes: $state, $props, $derived, $effect)
- Tailwind CSS v4 + Skeleton UI v4
- Auth: better-auth (via sv add-on)
- Database: SQLite libsql + Drizzle ORM (via sv add-on)
- Forms: SuperForms v2 + Zod v4
- Icons: Phosphor (phosphor-svelte) via centralized Icon.svelte wrapper
- Rich Text: Tiptap
- Logging: Pino
- Testing: Vitest + @testing-library/svelte

## Key Conventions

- Color pairings mandatory: `text-surface-50-950` NOT `dark:` variants
- Raw colors forbidden: no `text-neutral-*`, `bg-white`, `text-red-*`
- Design tokens via `var(--token)` for spacing/radius/sizing, never hardcode
- Zod v4: `import { z } from 'zod/v4'`, adapters: `zod4` / `zod4Client`
- Svelte 5: `{@render children()}` not `<slot>`, `onclick={}` not `on:click`
- Skeleton UI components always used — never raw HTML for what Skeleton provides

## Theme System

3 layers, all overridable without touching components:
- `svelteForge.css` — 7 color domains × 10 shades (oklch)
- `tokens.css` — 60+ semantic tokens (padding, radius, sizing, typography)
- `fonts.css` — Inter, Space Grotesk, Manrope, Fira Code
- To create a theme: copy CSS files, change `[data-theme]` name + values

## Architecture

SvelteForge is an sv community addon using `defineAddon()` from the `sv` package.

```
svelteforge/
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts          ← defineAddon() entry (options, deps, file injection)
│   ├── templates.ts      ← AUTO-GENERATED (file contents as JSON strings)
│   └── modes/
│       ├── fullstack.ts  ← writes all fullstack files via sv.file()
│       └── landing.ts    ← filters fullstack + landing overrides
├── templates/
│   ├── fullstack/        ← fullstack mode source files
│   └── landing/          ← landing mode overrides
├── scripts/prebuild.ts   ← reads templates/ → generates src/templates.ts
├── tsdown.config.ts      ← bundles into dist/index.js
└── package.json          ← @ludoloops/svelteforge
```

Build: `prebuild` reads template files → inlines into `templates.ts` → `tsdown` bundles everything into `dist/index.js`.

## Template Structure

```
src/lib/
├── components/ui/       # 34 components (Card, DataTable, Toast, Modal, etc.)
├── components/layout/   # Navbar, Footer, AdminSidebar, AuthButtons, MobileMenu
├── components/icons/    # Icon.svelte (Phosphor wrapper, name→component map)
├── schemas/             # Zod v4 (signup, login, password, account, profile)
├── stores/              # notification-store.svelte.ts (Svelte 5 runes)
├── styles/              # svelteForge.css, tokens.css, fonts.css
└── utils/               # cn.ts, formatters.ts, slugify.ts, theme.svelte.ts, focus-trap.ts
src/routes/
├── (public)/            # /login, /signup
├── (protected)/         # /dashboard
│   └── admin/           # /admin (sidebar), /admin/users, /admin/settings, /admin/notifications
└── (legal)/             # /privacy, /legal
```

Auth config, DB, hooks.server.ts, and API routes are provided by `sv` — SvelteForge does not override them.

## Admin Dashboard (Full Stack)

Collapsible sidebar layout with:
- User management (DataTable, search, role filter, pagination)
- Settings (tabbed: General, Auth, Notifications)
- Notification system (create + manage, user bell + panel)

## Tests

83 tests across 11 files covering utils, schemas, stores, admin guard. Run with `npx vitest run`.
